task_and_failure: An owned Mac SSH client disconnect must not duplicate the durable synthetic checkpoint or lose the identity/result of a WSL native Dagu job. The first attempt also exposed an incorrect local SSH exit-code assertion.
discovery_provenance: Existing accepted job-recovery recipe and retained native WSL receipt; unchanged planner/fixture/oracle. No new discovery-list adoption.
license_and_compatibility: Existing Dagu 2.16.6 GPL-3.0 binary and license hashes verified before both runs. Mac native OpenSSH controls Linux WSL2 native Dagu; remote Python standard library 3.12.3.

baseline_and_candidate.baseline: Previously accepted native local checkpoint cancellation and selected-step retry; it did not establish SSH transport survival.
baseline_and_candidate.candidate: Terminate only the owned nonmultiplexed Mac SSH client after a durable checkpoint, freshly reconcile the same running WSL native run, then complete without stop or retry.

predeclared_metrics.quality_rule: Same native run running before and immediately after client disconnect, native succeeded without stop/retry, byte-identical durable checkpoint count 1, all 12 original tests before/after, frozen inputs unchanged, owned client/controller/processes/listeners retired. Preserve the prior failed attempt and narrower repair.
predeclared_metrics.usage_rule: Deterministic fixture model calls and local model token categories zero. Enclosing coordinator/agent usage unknown; no savings claim.

runtime_and_platform.platform: Mac native SSH client to Linux WSL2 x86_64, isolated task prefixes
runtime_and_platform.isolation: New task-owned prefixes, DAGU_HOME and minimal child environment preserving real HOME. Native Dagu starts in a separate process session with file-backed logs. Nonmultiplexed independent SSH sessions; only the owned local client is signalled. No global service, account, package or host-network mutation.

observations.scope: Mac-owned SSH client termination and fresh-connection reconciliation of the same detached WSL Dagu run, without native stop or retry
Same-run native stop and selected-finalizer retry recovery after the preserved harness failure; transport survival unqualified

failures_and_skips.reason: Native SSH handled the owned SIGTERM by exiting 255 with empty stderr; frozen harness required -15 and failed before reconnect. Explicit failure cleanup then stopped the job. Diagnostic same-run finalizer retry is a separate narrower observation.

limitations: Controlled local SSH-client termination is not evidence of a real network outage, power loss, host restart or credential recovery.
Separate remote process session and file-backed logs deliberately remove SSH-pipe dependence; this does not qualify arbitrary foreground processes.
Exclusive checkpoint claim is a local synthetic effect, not distributed exactly-once external side effects.
No model, provider, broker, GPU, global service, authentication or package changes.
Enclosing agent usage remains unknown; no token-savings claim.
Raw native IDs, process identities, generated host paths and command logs remain private. Published hashes establish byte identity, not independent observation truth.
Process retirement covers observed owned identities and listeners; no exhaustive host audit.
The fixed synthetic oracle was already accepted; no application/model session, external effect or hidden-test benchmark was run.

decision_and_scope.scope: Mac-owned SSH client termination and fresh-connection reconciliation of the same detached WSL Dagu run, without native stop or retry

rollback: Owned clients, observed remote processes and listeners exited. Preserve evidence, then retire only task-owned prefixes. No global service/account/configuration change to roll back.
next_decision_changing_test: A separately frozen, authorized stronger failure mode or real native-agent session recovery experiment; controlled SSH client termination does not qualify power loss or arbitrary network partitions.
